From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Dec 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Safeguard Rate Authorization for Synthetix Health Pilot

Team —

Quick one: Synthetix Health (prospect) is asking for a materially discounted pilot to win a strategic POC with a large payer partner. Key asks from them: 50% list-rate off for first 6 months, VPC deployment (private), and a two-year commit thereafter. They want a signed LOI by EOD Tuesday to keep the partner meeting schedule intact.

Why this matters: if we lose momentum the partner timeline slips by a quarter — high strategic signal. Upside is a potential enterprise conversion inside 12 months ($1.2M ARR ramp if they go live). Downside is margin pressure early and the VPC add-on increases our operational cost.

What I'm requesting from leadership/finance:
- Exec clearance to offer a structured concession in lieu of a straight 50% off (recommendation below).
- CFO sign-off for a capped discount pattern and/or onboarding credit.
- Legal check: DPA/data residency implications for VPC (may require Private deployment premium).

My recommended structure (to preserve margin and incentivize conversion):
- 6-month time-limited effective discount that phases: month 1–3 = 40% off list, month 4–6 = 25% off list; thereafter standard list but with 2-year committed ARR target tied to ramp credits.
- $75k onboarding credit (one-time) payable as usage credits, reclaimable if we don't hit minimum commit in 12 months.
- Require DPA + SOC2 evidence; VPC add-on billed at standard Private SKU (no discount).
- Include a revenue-protection clause: if actual usage outpaces forecast by >30% we revert to standard list for overage tokens.

Attachments: SYNT-LOI.pdf (customer LOI), deal-summary.xlsx (my ask + ACV math).

Can we get a decision or conditional sign-off by EOD Tuesday (2028-12-05)? If finance needs numbers I can push more detailed ACV timing.

Thanks —

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 4 Dec 2028 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Safeguard Rate Authorization for Synthetix Health Pilot

Thanks — ran the numbers and attached a quick impact model (finance-impact-synthetix.xlsx). Headline:
- If they convert to 100% of forecast over 12 months, NPV is positive and payback ~9 months even with a 40% initial concession + $75k onboarding credit.
- If they hit only 50% of the forecast, gross margin for year 1 falls by ~21 pts and payback slips past 18 months.

My recommendation: conditional approval with hard guardrails:
1) Cap net effective discount at 35% averaged across the first 6 months (we should avoid a hard 50% off).
2) Offer a $50k onboarding credit (smaller than proposed) that converts to usage credits and is reclaimable if 12-month committed ARR is not met.
3) Require the VPC/private deployment to be billed at our Private SKU list price (no discount), and legal to confirm any additional ops cost offset.
4) Include a clawback clause for sustained underperformance and a pre-agreed step-up schedule if usage grows above plan.

Legal note (from my quick pass): data residency + DPA will likely push them toward our Private deployment product; that raises our cost of delivery. If the customer insists on a discount on Private SKU, that would require explicit CFO sign-off beyond the 35% cap.

Attaching: finance-impact-synthetix.xlsx (model)

If you want me to sign off formally I can approve up to the structure above; if you need the 50% headline we will need an exec-level revenue protection plan and offsetting commercial concessions (e.g., multi-year non-cancelable commit with minimum ARR).

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Finance (Interim CFO)
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Safeguard Rate Authorization for Synthetix Health Pilot

Marissa / Aditya —

Executive decision: I am signing off on the following conditional concession, effective for this pilot only, contingent on Legal and Sales acceptance of the guardrails below. This constitutes CFO approval for the commercial team to present the offer to Synthetix.

Approved structure (CFO sign-off):
- Net effective discount capped at 35% across months 1–6 (example: months 1–3 at 35%, months 4–6 at 15%).
- One-time $50,000 onboarding credit issued as usage credits; refundable by clawback if 12-month committed ARR minimum is not met per the attached LOI.
- Private/VPC SKU billed at list (no discount). Any request to discount Private SKU requires separate CFO approval.
- Clawback & step-up: if usage <70% of committed ARR at 12 months, onboarding credit is reclaimed pro-rata; if usage >120% we automatically move to standard list rates for overage.

Conditions before sending to customer:
1) Legal to confirm DPA and any bespoke data residency language (Angela from Synthetix legal will be looped by Aditya).
2) Sales to confirm go/no-go on the reclaim mechanics and step-up language.

If those items are green, consider this approved — Laura Bennett (Interim CFO).

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance (Interim CFO), Redwood Inference
